newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residue up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residue up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 793,000 barrels in the week ended January 8 to 11 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 251,000 barrels to 7.717 million barrels. Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks were down by 139,000 barrels to 5.836 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
